descriptions.w3d_d28g_body_motion_range_response_8004: Applies a motion's range response to a body unless the body's +124 flag is set: within the +28 radius of the motion position it runs the countdown step scaled by distance and the +20 strength; within the +30 radius of the motion velocity vector it nudges the body along the normalized offset, scaled by distance and the +24 strength.
